decision_rules.title: The discount ladder
decision_rules.body: Up to 15% off list: the account executive decides. 15% to 25%: RevOps signs off, with a reason in the deal note. Above 25%, or any multi-year price lock: Amara.
decision_rules.evidenceQuote: up to 15% off list, the account executive decides. Between 15% and 25%, I sign off, and I want a reason in the deal note. Anything above 25%, or any multi-year price lock, goes to Amara.
decision_rules.verificationReason: Evidence quote appears verbatim in the source transcript.

decision_rules.title: No renewal date, no discount
decision_rules.body: Never approve a discount unless the opportunity has a renewal date.
decision_rules.evidenceQuote: I never approved a discount without a renewal date on the opportunity
decision_rules.verificationReason: Evidence quote appears verbatim in the source transcript.

decision_rules.title: 15% to 25% approvals after Theo
decision_rules.body: Elise Moreno takes the 15% to 25% approvals until a new RevOps lead starts, working from the pricing sheet.
decision_rules.evidenceQuote: Elise has agreed to take the 15 to 25 percent approvals until a new RevOps lead starts.
decision_rules.verificationReason: Evidence quote appears verbatim in the source transcript.

decision_rules.title: Greenbridge's late discount ask
decision_rules.body: Hold Greenbridge Systems at 15% unless they add seats.
decision_rules.evidenceQuote: hold the line at 15% unless they add seats

playbooks.title: Renewal calendar
playbooks.body:
1. 90 days out: open a renewal opportunity in HubSpot and tag the customer success owner.
2. 60 days: send the usage summary from the Insights admin export.
3. 30 days: send the quote; copy Finance the same day.
4. 14 days with no reply: Elise calls the sponsor.
playbooks.evidenceQuote: Ninety days before a renewal, I open a renewal opportunity in HubSpot and tag the customer success owner.
playbooks.verificationReason: Evidence quote appears verbatim in the source transcript.

playbooks.title: Quotes go to Finance the same day
playbooks.body: When a renewal quote goes out, Finance gets a copy that day so invoicing is not a surprise.
playbooks.evidenceQuote: At thirty days, the quote goes out, and Finance gets a copy the same day so invoicing is not a surprise.
playbooks.verificationReason: Evidence quote appears verbatim in the source transcript.

playbooks.title: A customer goes quiet
playbooks.body: No reply 14 days before renewal: Elise calls the sponsor directly.
playbooks.evidenceQuote: If a customer has not replied by fourteen days, Elise calls the sponsor directly.
playbooks.verificationReason: Evidence quote appears verbatim in the source transcript.
